home.title: Choose your deck
home.sub: Pick a deck, then a game. You play against bots, right in your browser.
deck.italian.name: Italian deck
deck.french.name: French deck
deck.french.desc: 52 cards + jokers · hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades
games.title: Choose a game
play.quitHint: An unfinished game is not counted in your statistics.
round.title: Round {n}
stats.empty: No games played yet. Go deal some cards!
stats.resetConfirm: All your statistics will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
stats.note: Statistics are saved only in this browser. Clearing the site data deletes them.
man.t.hand: Your cards are at the bottom: tap or click one to play it.
man.t.opps: The other players are at the top, with the number of cards they hold and their score.
man.t.turn: A golden border shows whose turn it is.
man.t.deck: The number on the deck tells you how many cards are still to be drawn.
man.t.trump: The face-up card next to the deck is the trump: cards of that suit beat every other suit.
man.t.center.trick: The cards played in the current trick appear in the middle, each with the name of who played it.
man.t.center.fishing: The cards in the middle are on the table and can be captured. The cards you are about to take are outlined in gold.
man.t.pile: The badge with two stacked cards counts the cards each player has captured.
man.c.hint: The light-bulb button suggests a card to play when you are unsure.
man.c.leave: The arrow at the top left leaves the game; the question mark reopens this guide without leaving.
man.c.settings: Language, theme, size, game speed and sounds are in the settings.
sol.newHint: The current game will be counted as lost.
man.s.stock: Top left is the stock: tap it to turn over new cards. Only the last card turned can be played.
man.s.found: Top right are the four foundations, one per suit: build each one upwards starting from the Ace.
man.s.cols: Below are the columns. Only face-up cards can move; a face-down card is turned over as soon as it is uncovered.
man.s.tap: Tap a card and it moves by itself to the best legal place, or drag it where you want; a card in the middle of a column takes the whole sequence below it along.
man.c.undo: Undo takes back your last move; New deal starts again with a fresh shuffle.
play.howMany: How many cards do you play?
man.d.pile: The pile in the middle shows the last cards played: you must play a card of the same value or higher than the one on top.
man.d.table: Next to your hand are your table cards, three face up and three face down: you play them only when your hand and the deck are empty.
rum.draw: Draw a card: tap the deck or the discard pile
rum.play: Lay down, add to the table, or discard
rum.invalid: These cards do not form a valid combination
rum.keepOne: You must keep one card to discard
rum.openFirst: Opening not reached: {n}/{of}. Lay down more or take the cards back
rum.noPick: You can take from the discard pile only after opening
rum.sameCard: You cannot discard the card you have just picked up
rum.pickFirst: First select the cards in your hand, then tap the combination
rum.lowWins: Cards left in hand are penalty points: the lowest total wins.
rum.bLay: {name} adds a card to a combination
man.r.piles: On the left are the deck and the discard pile: at the start of your turn tap one of them to draw.
man.r.melds: The combinations on the table belong to everybody: once you have opened, select cards in your hand and tap a combination to add them.
man.r.hand: Tap the cards in your hand to select them, then use Lay down or Discard. Sort rearranges your hand by suit or by value.
bur.needBurraco: To go out your team needs a burraco (a combination of 7 cards): keep at least two cards
bur.notYours: You can add cards only to your own team’s combinations
mach.turn: Play cards from your hand, or tap the deck to draw
mach.fix: Some combinations on the table are not valid (outlined in red)
mach.playOne: Play at least one card from your hand, or draw
man.m.table: Every combination on the table can be taken apart: tap any card on the table to select it, together with cards from your hand.
man.m.buttons: “New combination” puts the selected cards in a new group; the + next to a group adds them there. Groups that are not valid are outlined in red: you can end your turn only when every group is valid.
man.m.draw: If you cannot or do not want to play, tap the deck to draw a card: your turn ends.
play.partnerIs: {name} played the called card: the partner is revealed!
ask.bid: Auction: call a lower card, or pass
ask.suit: You won the auction: choose the trump suit
man.k.auction: At the start a window asks for your call in the auction: tap the card value you want to call, or Pass.
man.k.card: During play the called card is shown on the left of the table: its suit is the trump.
sm.turn: Ask for a card or stand
man.b.bank: The bank is at the top: its first card stays face down until every player has finished.
man.b.you: Your cards and your total are at the bottom: “Card” asks for another card, “Stand” ends your turn. The other players’ first card is hidden from you.
man.b.chips: The number next to ● is each player’s chips. After every hand a badge shows what each player won or lost; “Next hand” deals again.
resume.banner: You have a game in progress: {name}
man.c.resume: If you close or reload the page, the game in progress is saved on this device: you can resume it from the home page or from the game options.
man.c.last: The clock-arrow button shows again the cards of the last trick or capture.
man.m.drag: You can also drag: drop a card (or the selected cards) onto a combination to add it there, or onto an empty part of the table to start a new one.
